page.layout: One text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ris nominibus appellarentur. Item ventos duodecim nominibus propriis insignivit: quum prius non amplius quàm vix quatuor ventorum vocabula inveniri possent. MenMenses insignivit nominibus vernaculis[?]sium quidem Januarium appellavit Winthermonet, Februarium Hornung, Martium Lenzmonet, Aprilem Ostermonet, Majum Wunnemonat, Junium Brachmonet, Julium Heuwmonet, Augustum Aernmonet, Septembrem Herbstmonat, Octobrem Wynmonet, Decembrem Heiligmonet. Ventis verò hoc modo nomina imposuit, ut Subsolanum vocaret Ostrenwind, EurumItemque ventos. Ostsundren, Euro-austrum Sundostren, Austro-africum Sundwestren, Africum Westsundren, Zephyrum Westren, Corum Westnordren, Circium Nordwestren, Septentrionem Nordren, Aquilonem Nordostren, Vulturnum Ostnordren.

Vuasthaldus res Francorum, qui in Germania Franci vocantur, descripsit patrio sermone, literis usus, uti refert Hunibaldus, per quàm similibus characteribus Graecis, nisi quòd epsilon & ypsilon & gamma inversa videntur. Et Trittemius auctor est, Julium Caesarem in castris Helvetiorum repertos characteres Graecos prodidisse.Vuasthal-dus vernacule aejcri-pfit res Francorum[?]

page.notes: Right-margin notes are small and partly faded; "vernaculis" and "aejcri-pfit" are doubtful readings. The note "Menses insignivit nominibus vernaculis" is reconstructed from fragmentary lines. Long s has been normalised to s throughout, as instructed. The running head is "DIVERSIS," with the comma as printed. The page ends mid-sentence at "ideoq;" and the paragraph continues on the next page.
